findings.title: BOLA/IDOR - Unauthorized Access to Other Users' Order Receipts
findings.description: The /order/<order_id>/receipt endpoint does not verify that the authenticated user owns the order being accessed. A logged-in user (test, user_id=10032) can access receipts belonging to other users by simply changing the order_id in the URL. Order 300401 belongs to another user and contains the CTF flag.
findings.tool_used: manual HTTP fuzzing (bash loop over order IDs 300000-300500)
